title: The Gender Equality Plan eligibility criterion in Horizon Europe: Who is concerned? How to comply with it?
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: A webinar for Legal Entity Appointed Representatives (LEARs) on the Gender Equality Plan requirement: which organisations it applies to, what the plan must include and how to declare it.
covers: Which organisations need a Gender Equality Plan: public bodies, higher education institutions and research organisations from Member States and Associated Countries
The mandatory requirements of the eligibility criterion
The practical steps the LEAR completes in the Participant Register
Examples of plans presented by two research organisations, followed by questions and answers
materials: Presentation slides, the Horizon Europe guidance on gender equality plans and the Commission's page on the eligibility criterion
why: A missing or incomplete plan can make a university or research centre ineligible, regardless of the quality of the proposal. LEARs should check compliance well before the first deadline they target.
source_name: European Commission · Research and innovation community platform (related webinars)
